review_finding.counterexample: ReviewModal and ReviewSaveOperation accepted 21 or more food photos. The client compressed and uploaded them before the AI-bound route rejected more than 20, while the photo-only insert path accepted the same draft.

implemented_contract.selection: File selection and drag/drop reject the whole over-limit addition, preserve existing files, and show a Korean error.
implemented_contract.ui: The counter displays current/max, restored over-limit drafts show an alert, step and submit validity fail above 20.
implemented_contract.submit: ReviewModal rejects 21 before readiness, compression, upload, insert, or draft deletion capture.
implemented_contract.operation: Only a newly created operation is subject to the maximum. Existing unknown/saved operations complete readback, cleanup, and saved-previous recovery before any new draft validation.
implemented_contract.paths: The operation boundary applies equally to photo-only direct insert and AI-bound route insert; the server parser imports the same maximum.
